description: Database della pericolosità sismica MPS04 is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by esse1.mi.ingv.it. The probabilistic seismic hazard maps of the Italian national territory are represented by shaking parameters on a regular grid spaced by 0.05° and using two shaking parameters, PGA (horizontal peak ground acceleration) and Sa(spectral acceleration). Coverage: the Italian national territory. Its keywords include Seismic hazard, open data, Probabilistic approach, Italy. The listing shows 3 download or service links in WMS, WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
